method.static: Every <svg> literal in the decoded app.js template (markup + script), behaviour scripts, static HTML pages and CSS data: URIs; JS-composed icons (mobilemenu.js ITEMS/I.bell/CHATICONS, chatcards.js _svg, slider.js arrows) resolved by evaluating their source maps.
method.runtime: Chrome via Playwright, every page at 1440x900 (desktop) and 390x844 (mobile), waitUntil load + 1.2s; messages.html also after opening a thread and the chat "..." menu. Collected every assets, CSS background/mask images incl. ::before/::after, and text-glyph icons.
method.dedupe: Canonical geometry: absolute path coordinates (2 dp), one entry per subpath/shape, order-insensitive, plus viewBox. Equivalent spellings of the same drawing collapse; paint differences are listed under sourceVariants / computedPaints.
method.svgFiles: Each .svg keeps the representative source markup exactly (paths, viewBox, width/height, fill, stroke, stroke-width, linecap/linejoin, per-shape paint). Layout-only inline style, class and aria attributes are dropped. Template bindings are resolved to the default state (item.favFill -> none).
method.figmaMatch: figma.match is exact / strong / probable (raster evidence, optionally confirmed semantically), semantic (hand-assigned: the Figma library has the same object but the HTML redraws it, so geometry differs; rasterScore shows how far), or none. Raster method: comparison against D:/Doc/q-bazaar-refs/iconlib.json (306 names, 212 distinct glyphs): both sides cropped to ink box, NCC at 16px and 28px, geometry mask and colour-aware mask averaged. exact >= 0.97, strong >= 0.90, probable >= 0.80, weak >= 0.70, else none. icon-audit.json holds only a 2-page layout audit (no glyph data).
method.postFixes: patch2.cjs: colours resolved from template data where the markup uses bindings or currentColor in a never-rendered branch (colourBasis), renderedStrokePx for CSS background icons, and template-script icon-map states labelled with their pages. 2026-10-10 home gap fill (parity-spec/work-home/gapfill-apply.cjs): +7 emoji flag glyphIcons (header language popover), +1 css-drawn icon footer-accordion-chevron.
